text:
maria: Alert: warm-pool GPU nodes in ap-northeast-3 failing at provisioning after a regional firewall segmentation. Keystore decrypts returning 403.

lee: metrics show join success dropped from 97% -> 58% at 10:23 UTC. Keystore LB traffic is being rejected by new zone ACLs. Not a KMS key issue.

tariq: reproduced on a failed instance: outbound to 10.77.44.9:443 gets TCP RST (firewall). The segmentation change moved tenant subnets into 'zone-b' which has strict outbound defaults.

ops-bot: [CANARY] 1797777777: ap-northeast-3 canary: 3/8 joins succeeded, 5/8 failed (keystore handshake). See /infra/canaries/2026-03-21/ap-northeast-3.log

maria: emergency mitigation options: 1) add a single-IP egress allow to keystore LB, 2) spin up a regional keystore mirror in the new zone, or 3) request firewall rollback from the cloud team (slow).

lee: prefer #1 as immediate patch. Keep rule minimal (single /32) and TTL <= 24h. Also record exception metadata for security/compliance.

tariq: tested in staging with this command: 
```
az network nsg rule create -g rg-core -n allow-keystore-outbound --nsg-name warm-pool-nsg --priority 205 --protocol Tcp --direction Outbound --destination-address-prefixes 10.77.44.9/32 --destination-port-ranges 443 --access Allow
```
Join rate recovered to 94% in 6m.

security-team: please create an exception ticket and include blast radius, justification, and rollback ETA. Audit impact for backfill needs to be calculated.

maria: creating INF-8010: exception for temporary egress allow (ap-northeast-3). Proposed window 18h, owner: lee, mitigation: auto-rollback script + monitoring. Cost note included.

lee: cost estimate: if we backfill join/audit logs for the failed nodes, expecting ~70GB/day -> ~$1.8k/week at current retention. Flagging to finance.

tariq: I'll implement auto-rollback: trigger NSG removal if join_success >= 95% for a 30m rolling window for 2 consecutive checks. Also add an alert to prevent accidental removal during ongoing incidents.

ops-bot: [ACTION] 1797777790: queued change: apply allow-keystore-outbound (10.77.44.9/32:443) with TTL 12h. Approve? reply yes/no

maria: yes. Apply.

ops-bot: [AUTOMATION] 1797777795: NSG rule created on warm-pool-nsg (prod-ap-northeast-3). Running canaries.

lee: canary results after change: 5/6 joins succeeded (83%) within 5m, keystore 403 errors down by ~90%. Monitoring trending positive.

security-team: INF-8010 recorded. Security provides conditional approval: 1) TTL <= 24h, 2) auto-rollback enabled, 3) attach canary logs and cost estimate, 4) backfill cap = 7d unless compliance requires full retention.

maria: attached logs and cost note. Action items: lee run auto-rollback script (now), tariq prototype regional mirror + evaluate timeline for privatelink (2w), maria to follow up with cloud network team to plan segmentation exceptions.

tariq: starting mirror prototype. Also will create a small design doc comparing privatelink vs regional mirror for keystore (latency/cost/complexity).

ops-bot: [AUTOMATION] 1797777802: Monitoring created: infra/monitors/keystore-ap-northeast-3. Auto-rollback scheduled at 12h unless overridden.

maria: closing this emergency thread once INF-8010 is in security queue and auto-rollback confirmed. Ping me for any regressions. :thumbsup:
